meta.title: NBA all-time candidates — one row per person
meta.shape: one row per PERSON. A source token that could mean several people contributes one row per person, each with its own position; the token is kept in source_tokens for the trail. No nicknames, no arrow notation, no combined entries.
meta.owner_instruction: 'Record all of these (if vague guessed at meaning then record all names possible)' — applied as one row per name.
meta.still_open_note: Brian Taylor — the Owner could not identify it, and no NBA player by that name can be asserted from the source. Left open rather than guessed.
meta.rating_status: no rating is assigned here; ratings come from the Owner.
